scoring_justification: Energy difference is recomputed from raw per-fu energies; band structure audited for crossings; rotation angles compared to paper DFT gold.

outputs.description: The agent's reported per-formula-unit energies and their difference for the two domain orientations. The checker recomputes the difference and compares the sign and magnitude with the paper's result.

Band eigenvalues along the high-symmetry path Γ–X–S–Γ–Y. The checker verifies that at least one band crosses the Fermi level along the out-of-phase path (Γ–X–S) while no band crosses along the in-phase path (S–Γ–Y).
In-plane and out-of-plane octahedral rotation angles extracted from the relaxed structure. The checker compares α, β, γ against paper-derived reference values with a tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The band structure audit is qualitative: presence/absence of Fermi level crossings along prescribed path segments. Energy difference and rotation angles are compared to paper-reported hidden gold values with appropriate tolerances.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 2c; energy difference per formula unit ~0.015 eV with in-plane lower. Derived from solve.sh and paper-reported stability.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Set to 0.015 eV with tolerance ±0.010 based on paper’s DFT result.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Value estimated from paper’s DFT result (Fig. 2c) and used as reference; consistent with solve.sh oracle.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper DFT results (Supplementary Table I and Fig. S13); rotation angles from heterostructure relaxation.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Alpha=11.0°, beta=11.0°, gamma=10.0°, typical for ultrathin SIO/STO DFT calculations; tolerance ±0.5°.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are consistent with paper-reported DFT-calculated M-O-M bond angles converted to rotation angles, and match solve.sh oracle.

steps.description: Recompute energy difference from per-fu energies and verify orientation.
Audit band structure for Fermi level crossing along Γ-X-S and absence along S-Γ-Y.
Compare α,β,γ against paper-derived DFT values.
